en: The available account gives no soldier or alate description for this species; only the host and the localities are recorded. Material was taken from Masson pine in Haifeng, Guangdong, and the species is also known from Guangxi. Morphological characters therefore cannot be summarised, and the taxon rests solely on its original description within Reticulitermes, a genus of subterranean termites whose soldiers have a rectangular head, stout mandibles and a slender postmentum.
taxonomy_note: 原书属名印作 Reticuliter mes，系 Reticulitermes 之讹拼，现归入散白蚁属 Reticulitermes。
